messages:
jordan: Heads-up — I'm going to ship a 'compact edit' mode for SLO notification rules in the console next week. Want quick API/UX callouts before I flip the feature flag.

mira: Nice. What's 'compact edit' exactly? Can tenant-level overrides still be set?

jordan: Compact = single-line condensed editor for quick threshold tweaks + quick toggle for notify channels. Not removing full editor. Tenants keep overrides. Goal: reduce clicks for ops teams.

theo: API-wise we need an idempotent patch endpoint for partial updates. Right now client does full PUT which is noisy. Proposal: add PATCH /v1/slo-rules/:id with body like:

```json
{ "notify": ["pagerduty"], "thresholds": {"p99_latency_ms": 1200} }
```

riley: +1 for PATCH. Also need a preview modal so users see which services will be alerted before saving. Prevents noise.

jordan: Agreed on preview. UX will show a diff of contacts + simulated alert sample.

sean: How do we handle dedupe? If multiple rules hit, we should suppress duplicates for same contact within window. We have suppression logic in backend but console should surface it (e.g., "will be deduped").

theo: Backend supports dedupe-window config per-tenant. API field: `dedupe_window_seconds`. Default 300. We can expose in compact UI as a small dropdown: 1m/5m/15m.

mira: Edge case: tenant custom channels that are deprecated. Preview should warn if channel unreachable (500 on test send).

jordan: Good catch. We'll add a small healthcheck ping in preview path. If ping fails, show warning and allow override to save anyway.

deploy-bot: deploy: rolling update of eng-platform-console v2.14.3 started by @jordan (CI pipeline #4521) :rocket:

riley: One more ask — telemetry: add an event `slo.compact_edit_submitted` with props {user_id, tenant_id, changed_fields, preview_accepted}. Helps measure regression/noise.

theo: We'll add the telemetry and bump API to return `preview_issues: ["channel_unreachable"]` so console can display warnings.

jordan: Plan: land PATCH API PR today, console compact UI + preview tomorrow, feature flag off by default. I'll post a short rollout doc with rollback steps. Anyone want to pair on validation tests?

mira: I can take validation tests for tenant override matrix.

sean: I'll add dedupe e2e scenarios.

jordan: Thanks. If no objections I'll merge the API PR after code review. Will post link when done. :thumbsup:
